description: A three-member group -- two violet rounded boxes and the arrow between them -- whose one `glow` is on the group clip, and on none of its members. Expect all three lit by the same soft violet halo: round both boxes, inside them as well as outside, and along the arrow. The group is one picture by the time the glow is grown from it. What a wrong render looks like: only one member glowing, or none, means the glow was read off a member rather than the group's composited canvas; a halo cut off square at the edge of the frame's middle means the group canvas was not padded; the boxes' outlines turning soft means the glow replaced the layer instead of being drawn under it.
